fact: Law 058/2021 of 13/10/2021, in force 15 October 2021, was adopted pursuant to the African Union Convention on cyber security and personal data protection, ratified by Presidential Order n 104/01 of 18/09/2019.
title: Law relating to the Protection of Personal Data and Privacy (Law No 058/2021 of 13/10/2021)
publisher: Official Gazette of the Republic of Rwanda
